text: Integrating stablecoins pegged to fiat currencies gives a token ecosystem a stable transactional medium and mitigates the volatility that otherwise attaches to cryptocurrencies, alongside DeFi services that let users earn returns and access credit outside the banking system.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Quantum Economy and Tokenomics (2024). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=4900878
abstract: The integration of stablecoins pegged to fiat currencies provides a stable medium for transactions, mitigating the volatility often associated with cryptocurrencies.

value: the VOW ecosystem as a case study
